channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Julius Erving | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Julius Erving from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Spencer Haywood on Glen Davis, Julius Erving
item.description:
“So it’s up in the air. It’s just sad, man. Some of the names I was saddened to hear, like Glen Davis, I was like wait a minute, I didn’t think he was that kind of a person. He’s made, what, $40 million in salary? What are you doing man? It hurts because all of these young guys, instead of working with the players’ union and trying to make it better, they’re trying to take away from it and all of these people’s reputations. Julius Erving is under this program, all of us are. People put it on the line so we can have a great league and on the 75th anniversary [of the NBA], this is what we’ve got?”

Spencer Haywood on Glen Davis, Julius Erving, Oct 9, 2021. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Paul Mokeski on Larry Bird, Julius Erving
item.description:
“We would run into Philly with Dr. J. (Julius Erving), the Celtics and Larry Bird and that group, and it was very frustrating.”

Paul Mokeski on Larry Bird, Julius Erving, Jul 19, 2021. Source: Spokesman-Review.

item.title: Isiah Thomas on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Julius Erving
item.description:
Thomas recalled explained.

“My focus was Bird, Magic, Dr. J [Julius Erving], Kareem Abdul-Jabbar. Those were the guys. I don't care what anybody says. You can go back and look at history — those were the guys.”

Isiah Thomas on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Julius Erving, Nov 12, 2020. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Julius Erving
item.description:
“I was embarrassed. We go up to the circle, you know, the starting lineup. I had never met Dr. J. So I walk up to him and I put my hand out and say, ‘Hey, Mr. Erving, Dr. J, Glenn Rivers.’ And he says, ‘Doc Rivers.’And for me that was really cool that he did that, because it just showed the class of Julius — as you know, one of the classier men in the world.”

Doc Rivers on Julius Erving, Oct 6, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Clyde Drexler on LeBron James, Michael Jordan, Jerry West, Larry Bird, Oscar Robertson, Elgin Baylor, Julius Erving, George Gervin
item.description:
Drexler also offered up suggestions on a handful of other NBA greats.

“And then you've got guys like Dr. J [Julius Erving], Larry Bird, George Gervin, Elgin Baylor, Oscar Robertson, Jerry West. All those guys are in the conversation,and so for people to bring this up today, to me it's just unbelievable. And I love Michael and LeBron. But still, let's not take something away from those other guys who played.”

Clyde Drexler on LeBron James, Michael Jordan, Jerry West, Larry Bird, Oscar Robertson, Elgin Baylor, Julius Erving, George Gervin, May 29, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: David Thompson on LeBron James, Kevin Durant, Julius Erving
item.description:
“First, I started out using Dr. J (Julius Erving) and (kids) would say, ‘Who is that?’ Now, it’s more LeBron, Steph and Kevin Durant,”

David Thompson on LeBron James, Kevin Durant, Julius Erving, Nov 18, 2018. Source: FayObserver.com.

item.title: Nate Robinson on Gerald Green, Dennis Rodman, Julius Erving, Dominique Wilkins
item.description:
“A guy like Gerald Green controls his hops and his jumps are for a purpose. Julius Erving had big hands. He was always moving the ball all around; he made it look like magic in the air. Then you have explosive dunkers who jump high and dunk hard like Dominique Wilkins. Me? I'm an energy jumper. My jumping ability is more like an explosive Dennis Rodman, and since I'm shorter, it looks crazy. I'm just a guy out there who's trying to show the world what I can do. Not too many 5-9 guys can dunk like I can.”

Nate Robinson on Gerald Green, Dennis Rodman, Julius Erving, Dominique Wilkins, Jan 18, 2013. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Adam Aron on Julius Erving
item.description:
“When the playoffs started, it made sense to have Julius [Erving] bring out the first ball, since we had just announced that he was joining the organization as an employee,”

Adam Aron on Julius Erving, May 27, 2012. Source: Philadelphia Inquirer.
